name: band
from: Tabler Icons (tabler.io/icons), and three drawn here
//: The row, left to right, and that order is the whole idea: each mark rides its own slice of the spectrum, so the low end of the room is at the left and the cymbals are at the right. See wordsBeatRide.
//heights: The dot heights a mark is baked at, and the stroke it is drawn with at each. thick is in dots, and it is the whole reason these are drawings rather than a font: a stroke set per size comes out the same weight at every size, where a font's thins away small and fattens large. Three rather than two — measured, at two the threshold leaves a dashed line.
